GATE PAIR, and this one is the point of the event -- it is NOT an angle inversion but a DEGENERACY: accepted 69023 at 3.0 cm / 133.1deg (site from_vertices (walk_add)) against rejected 65017 at 2.8 cm / 133.0deg -- same distance, same angle to 0.1deg, opposite outcome. The only difference between them is cluster membership: 69023 is cluster 69, the same cluster as the shower seed, so the vertex walk reached it; 65017 is cluster 65 and no geometric pass covers 133deg. So on this event the accept/reject boundary is set by cluster connectivity, not by the dist/angle gate at all.
